browser.flow: Pending seller registers store; admin approves; seller creates fabric and uploads photo; admin posts; buyer filters and views recommendations, creates inquiry; seller answers; buyer returns to preserved search and requests pickup; seller accepts, calendar shows it, then completes pickup; buyer reloads final state and sees stock reduced from 900 to 720 cm.
browser.demoRegression: Preview buyer screen list opens the original demo fabric independently of the live transaction.
browser.profileCoverage: Current actual API scenario plus preceding inquiry-profile browser QA; no duplicate profile edits in this browser run.
